title: Enterprise Deep Research: The Next Killer App for Enterprise AI — Ofer Mendelevitch, Vectara
talk_summary: This is a short vendor pitch for Vectara's agent platform and its 'enterprise deep research' feature, which runs multi-agent, parallel, reflective search over private enterprise data with citations and hallucination mitigation. It is almost entirely marketing with no implementation detail, benchmarks, or cost/latency numbers beyond a generic '20-30 minutes' runtime and a third-party stat about factual accuracy.

takeaways.technique: Parallel sub-agents with a synthesis/reflection pass
takeaways.what_they_do: Deep research is described as a multi-agent process that runs sub-agents in parallel, reflects on intermediate results, and synthesizes a final cited report.
takeaways.evidence_quote: multi- aent with reflection with synthesis of the final results parallel execution of of agents underneath

takeaways.technique: Hallucination detection/correction model as a gate
takeaways.what_they_do: They run a dedicated hallucination-detection model (HHEM) over generated output to flag and correct unsupported claims, positioned as the enabler of high-quality research.
takeaways.evidence_quote: our hallucination detection model, also called HHM, has just passed 5 mill downloads
takeaways.numbers: ~5.5M downloads of HHEM (adoption, not an accuracy result)

takeaways.what_they_do: They claim 'corpus understanding' lets the agent plan the investigation based on what data actually exists before executing searches.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we have corpus understanding which allows you to plan properly based on your data
